description: This file contains functions for fetching, managing, and updating team and organization data, including members, event types, and related operations within a project. It interacts with a database via Prisma and references various internal modules for data processing.

methods.name: getTeamWithMembers
methods.description: Fetches detailed team or organization data including members, event types, and metadata, with options for viewing as team or organization.

methods.name: getTeamWithoutMembers
methods.description: Retrieves team or organization data without member details, including metadata and invite tokens.

methods.name: isTeamOwner
methods.description: Checks if a user is an owner of a specific team.

methods.name: isTeamMember
methods.description: Checks if a user is a member of a specific team.

methods.name: generateNewChildEventTypeDataForDB
methods.description: Generates data for creating a new child event type in the database, including optional workflows and user connections.

methods.name: updateNewTeamMemberEventTypes
methods.description: Adds default event types for new team members, creating or updating event types and associating users and workflows.

methods.name: addNewMembersToEventTypes
methods.description: Adds new members to existing event types and manages related database connections, workflows, and user associations.
